sn29.11-20:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.11-20:1.2: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.1: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī.
sn29.11-20:2.5: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn29.11-20:2.11: 8. 1. 14. yānadāyaka aṇḍaja suttaṃ yānaṃ deti …pe… upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.12: 8. 1. 15. mālādāyaka aṇḍaja suttaṃ mālaṃ deti …pe… upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.13: 8. 1. 16. gandhadāyaka aṇḍaja suttaṃ gandhaṃ deti …pe… upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.14: 8. 1. 17. vilepanadāyaka aṇḍaja suttaṃ vilepanaṃ deti …pe… upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.15: 8. 1. 18. seyyadāyaka aṇḍaja suttaṃ seyyaṃ deti …pe… upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.16: 8. 1. 19. āvasathadāyaka aṇḍaja suttaṃ āvasathaṃ deti …pe… upapajjatīti.
sn29.11-20:2.18: so kāyassa bhedā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn29.11-20:2.19: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacce kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
